svg.title: Pearson Specter backend health workflow
svg.desc: Watch processing, tiered response with reviewed-stock checks, onboard treatment approvals, and delayed Earth report acknowledgments.
svg.text: Pearson Specter · health workflow
JavaScript API stores results; existing Python watch and manager agents run as workers.
Watch sample and detect
Store timestamped vitals · apply flags, activity and rules
Response tier?
Log condition and decision
Tier 1
Tier 2
Tier 3
Automatic response proposal
15-second cancel window
Needs reviewed dose quantity and stock
If missing, record dose as unavailable
Only actual administration to leader moves command.
Decider approval
Tier 2 dose waits for astronaut's decider
Approval requires reviewed quantity and stock
Then the astronaut confirms the dose
A 60-second timeout escalates that decision once.
Crew alert
Send first-response instructions
Decider approval or 60-second timeout
Administration requires quantity and stock
The alert recipient sees only the addressed alert.
Daily check-in and assessment
Use sleep, mental-health answers, watch data and events to create a plan
Plan items are decided on board by the astronaut's decider.
Weekly and emergency reports
Weekly report written by acting leader; emergency report on event
No Earth link: queue report. Link restored: dispatch it.
Location sets one-way arrival and round-trip delay.
Worker stores a simulated acknowledgment after review time.
Audited PostgreSQL state
Vitals · plans · alerts · medication events · inventory · reports
Decision outcomes use one conditional update.
RLS applies self, decider, leader and alert-recipient access.
Inventory starts empty; unreviewed doses are never marked administered.
Workflow source: uml/health-workflow.mmd · Treatment approvals remain on board.
